info.title: Imbox V1 contracts
info.description: Operations distinguish implemented, development-only and contract-only status. Implemented means code exists, not that a deployment has enabled it. Browser routes use sessions and CSRF; machine routes use scoped short-lived bearer tokens without cookies. WebSocket frames are component schemas.
